notes.title: Small Bug Fixes & Window mode Added
notes.content:
Hello! Thanks to the community  feedback, some bugs were reported, and I was able to fix them!

This new version contains:


  Debug Levels
  Some UI Debug
  The achievement "Crash a Pot" is now in the correct level :)
  Now the Auto Pillars return to the position you had set, when you mistake a level!
  And, the function to toogle window mode/Fullscren is now added!


I hope you enjoy an amazing and pleasant experience with Skip Lake! 

Best Regards,
Rafael Almeida
RSoft Games.
